title: Junk, Amazon confirmed I ordered new one, I swear I was sent refurbished. HOT Exterior, dangerous
text: Junk, Amazon confirmed I ordered new one, I swear I was sent refurbished. HOT Exterior, dangerous. Returning tomorrow. I used one just like this over the summer and it was great, this was a piece of crap. I swear I was sent a refurbished one that didn't work properly and was all marked up instead of a new one even though Amazon confirmed I ordered a new one. if I wanted used I would just use Facebook Marketplace. There was a piece of plastic inside if I hadn't seen would have caught on fire and it was so hot on the outside to the touch within minutes I still have the blister on my finger trying to move from other items on the counter. This is dangerous item. And that's not even starting on all of the other things and scratches.

product_metadata.title: Black+Decker TO3210SSD 6-Slice Convection Countertop Toaster Oven, Silver
features: 20% Faster Cook Times - Built for performance. This BLACK+DECKER Convection Toaster Oven is designed to cook up to 20% faster than previous models
Convection Heating - The powerful convection fan circulates warm air throughout the oven for fast, even baking
Four Functions - The stainless steel/black toaster oven’s cooking functions include: baking, broiling, toasting, and keeping food warm
60-minute Timer - The 60-minute precision timer features stay-on functionality for longer baking tasks, plus the dedicated toast timer lets you get the perfect shade and crispness

12" Pizza, 6 Slices of Bread - The expanded toaster oven fits nicely on the countertop, while the curved interior makes room for 12 pizzas and 6 slices of bread. Three rack positions for improved cooking flexibility
description: Designed to cook up to 20% faster than previous models, the BLACK+DECKER 6-Slice Stainless Steel Countertop Convection Toaster Oven with Broiler Pan is built to satisfy hunger. With substantial interior space, you can easily cook a 12” pizza or even six slices of bread. The light-to-dark toast timer allows for easily repeatable variation depending on what you’re making. It comes with a baking and broiler pan that fits perfectly in the oven. Plus, toasting, baking, and broiling are all available cooking functions on this handy convection toaster oven. When it’s time to eat, trust the #1 brand in toaster ovens*—BLACK+DECKER. Large viewing window keep an eye on food during cooking. The durable glass window gives you a clear view of food throughout the cooking process. Removable crumb tray keeps counters clean and makes it easy to remove crumbs before they burn in the bottom of the oven.
